outline: 先修課程：負責教授同意。半導體材料、二極體、電晶體的原理、邏輯IC、記憶體IC。如物理沈積(PVD)、化學沈積(CVD)、高溫處理、微影、蝕刻及其相關設備介紹、廠物、維修、管理及工安等。並基礎奈米製程技術之介紹。
schedule:
Week	Course Contents
01	Introduction to semiconductor industry
02	Introduction to IC fabrication
03	Diffusion module
04	Thin-film module
05	Thin-film module
06	Photolithography
07	Etch
08	Etch
09	Mid-term exam.
10	High-k dielectric process (I): material and integrated process
11	High-k dielectric process (I): material and integrated process
12	High-k dielectric process (II): applications
13	Strained process
14	Strained process
15	SOI process
16	New-generation logic process applications
17	3-D IC process
18	Final exam
assessment:
Grading:
1.	Midterm Exam.: 20%
2.	Final Exam: 30%
3.	Quiz: 50%
